slides.say: The operation diamond is defined for every integer x. Diamond of x is four x when x is odd, and x squared minus nine when x is even. Diamond of diamond of diamond of one is equal to what?
A rule with conditions, one for odd and one for even. [short pause] So before each step, we check the input. And three diamonds, so inside out.
[short pause] Diamond of one. One is odd, so the odd rule, four x. Four times one is four.
Now four goes in. Four is even, so switch rules. Four squared minus nine, sixteen minus nine, seven.

Seven is odd again. Four times seven is twenty-eight. Choice number three is our answer. So check the parity at every step, because the output can switch sides. [pause] Okay. I'll see you in the next question.
